about.en: YPF Sociedad Anonima is Argentina's majority state-owned integrated energy company, active in exploration and production, refining, chemicals, electricity and fuel retailing, with its unconventional output centred on Vaca Muerta. YPF represents its NYSE-listed American depositary shares, each of which has represented ten Class D shares since the 1-for-10 split of the local line on 4 August 2026 moved the ADR ratio from 1:1 to 1:10, distinct from the Class D shares traded on ByMA as YPFD.
